q: Homoclinic bifurcation (orbit flip/inclination flip) occurs when a homoclinic orbit to a hyperbolic fixed point satisfies a non-generic tangency condition. Near such a bifurcation, the Shilnikov phenomenon predicts:
opts: Infinitely many periodic orbits and horseshoes if the saddle quantity σ = λ_u − |λ_s| > 0 (Shilnikov condition)
exp: Shilnikov homoclinic bifurcation (in 3D): if the fixed point is a saddle-focus with real eigenvalue λ_u > 0 and complex eigenvalues −ρ ± iω (ρ > 0), and the saddle quantity λ_u > ρ, then near the homoclinic orbit there are infinitely many periodic orbits of all periods — Shilnikov chaos. The Shilnikov condition λ_u > ρ is the key.
